decision.reason: [ev-1f885c8c6418] is only a one-line changelog entry. It names an internal function (UpdateRevisionForPaths) and says syncedRevision is now fetched there, and it points to issue/PR #21014/#21015. It does not describe the bug, the behaviour before and after the fix, which configurations or features reach that code path, or what symptom an unpatched environment would see. The linked issue/PR text or a release-note description is needed to write subject, change, applicability and consequence.
